items.description: Levent Alpoge's formal proof gives a route to GRH for Dirichlet L-functions, and with it the Riemann hypothesis. I wrote that proof out as mathematics papers a person can read, and placed it as the last row of a series that follows Weil's proof for curves, carried over to Spec ℤ. The chain is: three theorems on integral modular forms on unitary groups ⇒ a main inequality ⇒ a one-sided bound ⇒ a Landau-type criterion ⇒ GRH ⇒ RH. --Guide, 10 pages, no proofs: https://github.com/dtrejopizzo/riemann
